_readme: Photos on the site. To add one: drop the file in images/, add an entry here.
role   — 'hero' sits behind the masthead (one only; the first wins).
'panel' fills the background of the panel named in 'target'.
'gallery' joins the scrolling rail near the foot of the page.
target — for role 'panel'. Any section with a data-panel attribute:
Panels carrying dense numbers are best left clean.
focus  — CSS object-position. Nudge if a crop cuts someone's head off.
'50% 20%' pulls the crop up, '20% 50%' shifts the subject right.
alt    — read aloud by screen readers. Describe it, don't caption it.
credit — shown small under gallery photos. Leave empty to hide.
Unknown roles and targets are ignored, and a file that fails to load is
dropped silently, so nothing here can break the page.
